normative_extracts.spec_section: Media Queries Level 5 §11 User Preference Media Features
normative_extracts.quote: User preference media features (prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-color-scheme, prefers-contrast, forced-colors) expose OS-level accessibility and display settings to CSS and matchMedia().

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The browser subscribes to OS preference flags and re-evaluates CSS rules and window.matchMedia() listeners live when the user toggles dark mode, reduced motion, or High Contrast.

production_failures.symptom: Custom focus rings and SVG icons vanish completely in Windows High Contrast (forced-colors: active)
production_failures.root_cause: forced-colors mode strips custom background-color and box-shadow values, making box-shadow focus rings and dark SVGs invisible.
production_failures.mitigation: Use CSS outline (which forced-colors preserves), currentColor for inline SVGs, and forced-color-adjust: none only on calibrated swatches.

production_failures.symptom: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables critical loading spinners or JS scroll-to-section logic
production_failures.root_cause: Treating reduced-motion as 'zero animation' instead of replacing vestibular parallax/zooms with gentle opacity fades.
production_failures.mitigation: Replace transform/scale motion with short opacity transitions and gate JS scroll({ behavior: 'smooth' }) via matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').
